Interface Converter<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type of the value
public interface Converter<T>
Converts the text of a field to a value and back, for Form.bind(javax.swing.text.JTextComponent, be.imgn.swing.Property, Converter).

parse(String) rejects a text by throwing IllegalArgumentException or DateTimeException, which NumberFormatException and DateTimeParseException extend: the binding then leaves its property unchanged, and the converter's check, the first of the binding, is unmet. Any other exception is a bug in the converter.
